items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families; From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
items.claim: Moses was commanded to number the sons of Gershon aged thirty to fifty years old who perform service in the tabernacle, organized by family
items.place: throughout the houses of their fathers; in the tabernacle of the congregation
items.mechanism: by their families; all that enter to perform service
